timing: Persist close decisions before next XNYS open; simulate only saved intents at that next open. No retrospective signals or fills on missed-plan dates.
accounting: Provider total-return analytical units, normalized to persisted held-price anchors; raw one-share entry reference. Not broker shares, cash dividend payment or tax settlement replication.
missing_data: No imputation; incomplete rolling warm-up remains unready. Missing current eligible quote blocks planning; missing held/anchor quote blocks settlement without reset.
review: 60 planned-and-settled sessions permit manual process/cost review only. No automatic Paper/Live promotion or outcome-based parameter changes.
